name: KRas proto-oncogene, GTPase

function.text: KRAS encodes a small GTPase that switches between GDP- and GTP-bound states to relay receptor-derived signals to pathways controlling proliferation and survival.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include Noonan syndrome (autosomal dominant); cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations are described across multiple tumor groups, including Urachal carcinoma; Anal adenocarcinoma; Histiocytic sarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: KRAS encodes a small GTPase that switches between GDP- and GTP-bound states to relay receptor-derived signals to pathways controlling proliferation and survival.

germline.text: Germline disease associations include Noonan syndrome (autosomal dominant); cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KRAS have been reported in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, colorectal adenocarcinoma, and lung adenocarcinoma.
